offers.name: ASUS ROG Strix G16 16" 165Hz Gaming Laptop - Intel Core Ultra 7 255HX - 16GB DDR5 - 512GB SSD - RTX 5060 - Windows 11 - Eclipse Grey

reviews.quote: a fast gaming notebook with an RTX 5080 Laptop, which is an excellent match for the native QHD resolution of its matte IPS panel... the faster Ryzen 9 9955HX has to make do with the RTX 5070 Ti Laptop (reviewed 5080 config; CA retail tops out at 5070)

praises: Best FPS-per-dollar entry to the Strix G16 line — full-TGP RTX 5060 handles 1080p/1440p gaming with DLSS
Regular $2,499.95 with $1,999.95 sales — the sale price is a standout deal in the line
Modern Arrow Lake-HX Ultra 7 CPU despite the entry GPU
RAM (2x SODIMM) and storage (2x M.2) user-upgradeable — start at 16GB/512GB, cheap to grow
Same cooling and chassis as the $3,400 tiers
complaints: 16GB RAM and 512GB SSD out of the box — most buyers will want to upgrade immediately
Base FHD+ 165Hz panel is dim and low-gamut vs the Nebula HDR tier
RTX 5060 struggles with heavy ray tracing at QHD+ — this is a DLSS-dependent config
Battery short unplugged; Turbo fan noise
Plastic chassis flex; bulky power brick

design_philosophy: The volume-seller entry trim of the Strix G16: last-gen-plus CPU and a full-wattage RTX 5060 in the same chassis and cooling as the top tiers, priced to win the FPS-per-dollar fight — with obvious 16GB/512GB upgrade headroom by design.
